## Case studies

- [Unbond](https://govarthanan-ai-product-designer.netlify.app/unbond-case-study.html): A private companion app for employees serving a mandatory service bond — live countdown, document safety net, and salary/market-value benchmarking. Published on Google Play.
- [SDS Motion Forge](https://govarthanan-ai-product-designer.netlify.app/sds-motion-forge.html): An open-source, production-grade CSS animation library with 600+ animations, zero required JavaScript, and zero breaking changes across 5 versions — 1,857 organic npm downloads.
- [FrameStack PDF](https://govarthanan-ai-product-designer.netlify.app/framestack-pdf.html): A Figma plugin that exports multiple frames into a single PDF, designed and engineered solo — 4 versions shipped in 28 days, 34% lift in feature discovery.
- [Amazon Order Tracking Redesign](https://govarthanan-ai-product-designer.netlify.app/amazon-tracking-redesign.html): A UX case study redesigning clarity and trust in post-purchase order tracking, based on real user research.
- [River Rumble Blast](https://govarthanan-ai-product-designer.netlify.app/river-rumble-blast-case-study.html): Solo end-to-end event branding and digital campaign for Aura Elite Events — 0 to 1,200+ tickets sold in 20 days, 2.3M+ ad reach across 5 states.
